thread:
jordan.swe: Quick follow-up from the all-hands — can you clarify the timeline for the reorged Platform squad hires?

elena: Short answer: hires start next quarter; first wave is manager+ICs for core infra. Will share exact dates after budget sync.

mike.eng: To add — we're prioritizing teams that unblock Dedicated capacity and runtime stability. That means Platform infra and Eng-ML get earlier slots.

sophia.peopleops: We're aiming to open reqs the week of Apr 14. Hiring templates and interview loops will be posted in #devex.

nina.recruiter: FYI we'll run two parallel tracks: external and internal transfer. If you want to apply internally, ping me and I'll queue you for the internal screen.

jordan.swe: Thanks — will managers be required to backfill their ICs before a transfer is approved?

elena: Good Q. Transfers can be approved if the manager has a concrete plan to backfill within 60 days or can re-prioritize work without dropping SLOs. We don't want sudden capacity cliffs.

aj.platform: For clarity on headcount buckets: wave 1 = 12 FTEs (platform infra + runtime ops), wave 2 = 8 FTEs (eng-ml + serving runtime enhancements), wave 3 = remainder depending on hiring velocity.

jordan.swe: Is there a change to interview loops or rubric for senior infra roles?

sophia.peopleops: Slight tweaks — more emphasis on system design at scale and incident reasoning. We'll publish the updated rubrics here.

nina.recruiter: Also adding a short take-home for infra candidates (2 hour max) to assess large-system reasoning. Link to draft: https://intra.redwood/notes/infra-takehome (internal).

elena: On runway/budget — we have committed funding for Q2 hires. Q3+ depends on performance and customer metrics; we'll revisit in the mid-quarter review.

jordan.swe: What about managers that are wearing too many hats today — any plan to hire ICs first so managers can focus on org transition?

mike.eng: We'll mix approaches based on team risk. High-risk teams get ICs first; teams with critical leadership gaps may get manager hires prioritized.

sophia.peopleops: For managers moving to new roles as part of the reorg, we will provide a 30-60 day overlap period for knowledge transfer and a checklist for handoffs.

jordan.swe: Will there be public-facing org charts showing new reporting lines?

elena: Yes — we'll publish an updated org map and team charters by Apr 1. Expect a Slack thread per department with the new reporting lines.

aj.platform: Ops-bot note: "Hiring queue updated: 12 reqs prioritized; recruiters assigned." (ops-bot reaction :white_check_mark:)

nina.recruiter: Appreciate the heads-up. If folks have candidates or referrals, please DM me — referral bonuses still apply.

elena: Final note — if any manager expects capacity issues because of these changes, flag them to Mike and Sophia this week so we can adjust sequencing.

jordan.swe: Awesome, thanks. I'll loop my manager and we'll file any flags by EOD Friday. :thumbsup:

sophia.peopleops: Thanks everyone — we'll follow up with concrete timelines and the interview rubric doc in #devex tomorrow.
